annotations.title: Plan a PayRam install (step by step)

description: Start here to install PayRam on a VPS. Returns an ordered, personalised plan — prepare server → install → claim admin + set public URL → wallets (incl. Smart Bridge review) → API key + first payment link → hardening → store/app integration — with who runs each step (agent shell vs human/dashboard), exact commands, what success looks like, and hard stops that need the human (cold wallet, mainnet spend, root-only settings). Pass stage to resume mid-way.

domain.description: Public hostname for the gateway, e.g. pay.example.com. Omit if you only have an IP for now.

integration.description: What will take payments once the gateway is up

network.description: testnet = free test coins (recommended first); mainnet = real money

path.description: agent = headless CLI after a one-time interactive install; human = installer + web dashboard

role.description: merchant: Take payments for your own business (default). operator: Run PayRam as a platform for other merchants and earn a fee on their volume. Must be chosen before the first project; the role locks once role-specific data exists.

ssl.description: letsencrypt (needs domain), own_certificate, proxy (Cloudflare/your own reverse proxy terminates TLS), none. Default: letsencrypt with a domain, none without.

stage.description: Where you are now; the plan starts from the next step

wallet.description: First deposit wallet: usdc_base (smart-contract wallet on Base, needs a little gas), btc (xpub, no gas), or both

name: payram_setup_plan

gate.description: Why the agent must stop and get the human here
